item.description: In Chongzuo, Guangxi, at the southernmost tip of China, steep limestone peaks rise abruptly, disappearing into the humid and dense tropical rainforest. For tens of thousands of years, this green labyrinth of interwoven vegetation has not only swallowed sunlight and footprints but also preserved the secrets of ancient humans. In Baxian Cave and Naxian Cave on the west bank of the Zuojiang River, archaeologists identified nine tiny ancient human teeth among more than 18,000 mammalian...

item.description: The man facing allegations of artificial intelligence-assisted cheating was found dead on Thursday after South Korean police began searching for him. Lee Jin-woo, a Seoul National University (SNU) dental student, had gone missing since the previous night after telling reporters he would dispel the cheating allegations by publicly demonstrating his abilities by solving College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) questions in a live stream on Thursday. At its first appearance at auction, the painting Chataigniers en fleurs (Blossoming Chestnut Trees) set the highest price a Van Gogh painting has sold for at auction and the second highest for any artwork sold at Sotheby’s. item.description: As world leaders start a new day of talks at the Apec summit in Shenzhen, US President Donald Trump was seen seemingly dozing off in his seat. While President Xi Jinping was outlining China’s hopes for the Asia-Pacific, the 80-year-old appeared to nod off, live feed showed. Meanwhile, Russian President Vladimir Putin’s gaze remained fixed on the proceedings, and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Hong Kong’s leader John Lee took notes. item.description:
When Chinese President Xi Jinping broke decades of diplomatic precedent to greet US President Donald Trump on the tarmac in Shenzhen on Wednesday, cameras caught a woman in a striking yellow dress standing a few steps from the two leaders. That ever-present figure is Monica Crowley, the 35th chief of protocol of the United States.

item.description: Malaysians spent weeks expecting a disaster alert on their phones on Thursday – only to be told close to midnight on Wednesday that it would not be coming, causing them to question why the communications regulator waited so long to let them know. Since October, local media have been reporting that Malaysia is preparing to launch a nationwide system to send flood warnings directly to mobile phones, with the first trial to start on Thursday. item.dc:creator: Carol Yang
item.description: Apec leaders were given Chinese-style scarves to wear for the group summit photo on Thursday. It was a pared-back nod to the forum’s tradition of dressing attendees in the host economy’s sartorial heritage. The scarves came in two colours: red and blue. Most leaders, including Chinese President Xi Jinping, opted for red, while US President Donald Trump and his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin wore blue. The hem of each scarf is embroidered with the summit emblem, which features 21 intertwined...

item.description:
Under the neon glow of the Shenzhen skyline on Wednesday evening, US President Donald Trump offered onlookers an unexpected view of himself. As his armoured presidential limousine – known as “The Beast” – glided down Shenzhen’s avenues en route to the Apec welcome dinner, Trump was clearly visible as he looked through the thick glass to view the southern tech hub’s nightscape.
Video footage circulating online showed Trump gazing at the skyscrapers and raising his fist towards the delighted...

The music arranged to welcome Takaichi was the Japanese hit “Ue o muite arukou”, known as the Sukiyaki song in the West.
